contract_undead.name: Clear Undead Crypt
contract_undead.log_success: Force and magic together finally broke the crypt.
contract_undead.log_fail: Steel alone does not impress the dead.
contract_undead.log_blessing: Holy rites turned the dead aside. Faith, not the listed fee, decided this job.

contract_escort.name: Escort Merchant
contract_escort.hint: A steady blade and a calm voice
contract_escort.log_success: A steady guard and a calm voice kept the merchant on the road.
contract_escort.log_fail: The road wanted a firmer Defense and a clearer Leadership than the party brought.

contract_bandits.name: Drive Off Bandits
contract_bandits.hint: Sheer force works — but someone may get hurt
contract_bandits.log_success: Sheer Attack broke the camp before it could form a line.
contract_bandits.log_fail: The bandits held. This work answers only to enough raw Attack.

contract_ritual.name: Disrupt Dark Ritual
contract_ritual.log_success: Magic cracked the rite and Support kept the party from unraveling.
contract_ritual.log_fail: The rite held. Without enough Magic and Support, the circle does not break.
contract_ritual.log_blessing: Holy hands unpicked the dark rite. The extra coin is a quiet thanks.
